description: enable-auto-merge workflow fails 401 Bad credentials on every PR (dead PAT in GH_TOKEN secret) — auto-merge never arms itself. Observed on PRs #813/#814/#815 during the 2026-08-07 dogfood session.
resolution: Arm manually with local gh credentials: gh pr merge <n> --auto --squash (with operator authorization). Filed warren-2565 for the secret rotation.

description: Two Claude sessions sharing one checkout raced on git state: session A checked out another branch mid-flight, which discarded session B's uncommitted edits and let B's commit sweep up A's staged .seeds rows under B's message.
resolution: Amend the mislabeled commit, delete the mispointed branch, redo the work in a git worktree (.claude/worktrees/). Rule: concurrent agent sessions in one repo must each work in their own worktree.

description: An inherited GIT_DIR outranks a child process's cwd, so a test that spawns 'git config' against a mkdtemp fixture repo writes to GIT_DIR instead. Git exports GIT_DIR to every hook, and warren's pre-commit hook runs check:all -> check:coverage -> the test suite, so src/workspace/git/identity.test.ts wrote 'user.name = Local Bot' into the developer's own .git/config and five local commits (including the v0.14.1 release commit) carried that author.
resolution: Two layers: repoScopedGitEnv() in identity.test.ts drops every inherited GIT_* var and names GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE explicitly so the spawns can only touch the fixture; scripts/hooks/pre-commit strips GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE/GIT_PREFIX before exec'ing check:all so no future gate can repeat it. Verify with 'GIT_DIR=$PWD/.git GIT_WORK_TREE=$PWD bun test <file>' then check .git/config has no [user] section. Rule: cwd is not isolation for git subprocesses.
